candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because the downstream order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces show the same correlation IDs failing at order with 500 and at gateway with 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs and dependency metrics were not admitted, so the internal cause of the order 500 (db, redis, payment) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces tie each gateway 502 on /v1/checkout to an order-service 500 on /v1/orders within the same correlation IDs, and metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout. This bounds the fault to the order service returning 500, but the underlying order-side cause is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/errors explaining the 500 on POST /v1/orders
Order dependency operation metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
